description: 한국도로교통공단_지자체별 교통사고 다발지역 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로교통공단. 전국 각 지자체별 교통사고 다발지역 정보(지자체별 top3 지점) - 대상사고: 1년간 발생한 전체 교통사고 - 다발지역 선정조건: 반경 150m 내, 대상사고 3건 이상인 지점 중 상위 3개소(TOP3) 지자체별로 해당 조건에 해당하는 지점이 3개가 되지 않을 경우 1개 또는 2개 지점만 선정될... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로교통공단. Its tags are 교통사고, 사고다발지역, 전국, 지자체별, 상위3개소. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
